sentences.en: A fishing light wavers under the lee of an island.
sentences.zh: 在岛屿的背风处，一盏捕鱼灯摇曳不定。

sentences.en: Whoever leaves the office last should turn off the light.
sentences.zh: 最后一个离开办公室的人应该把灯关掉。

sentences.en: Little lights were blinking on and off in the distance.
sentences.zh: 远处有几盏微弱的灯光时明时暗。
